payload.objective: Independently compare the frozen plan, Worker candidate and Tester evidence; rerun exactly one Tester-declared deterministic command.
instructions: Read reports/gate3b/plan.json and reports/gate3b/tester-report.json; compare against all ACs and exact candidate manifest.

Independently rerun the Tester declared deterministic version-exact command exactly in the fixture root. Save raw stdout/stderr/exit. Compare exit code and stdout SHA-256 after CRLF-to-LF replacement only; record MATCH/MISMATCH and evidence.
Inspect the actual two-file diff and protected-file hashes; record findings. Do not edit product or CouncilFlow files.
Write reports/gate3b/reviewer-report.json as CouncilFlow 1.0 job.report with comparison and independent_rerun fields, exact candidate_ref, evidence refs, no created_at. Validate report.
